sanskrit: mithyopacaritā hy ete vartamānā hy anu priye ahitatvāya kalpante doṣā bharatasattama
english: For these faults, O best of the Bhāratas, though seemingly friendly while being indulged, lead only to harm.

sanskrit: tvam uktaḥ kuruvṛddhena mayā ca vidureṇa ca vāsudevena ca tathā śreyo naivābhipadyase
english: You have been counselled by the elder of the Kurus, by me, by Vidura, and by Vāsudeva, yet you do not take the path of your own welfare.

sanskrit: asti me balam ity eva sahasā tvaṃ titīrṣasi sagrāhanakramakaraṃ gaṅgāvegam ivoṣṇage
english: Thinking only 'I have strength,' you rashly seek to cross, as if in the hot season one would brave the current of the Ganges filled with crocodiles and sharks.

sanskrit: vāsa eva yathā hi tvaṃ prāvṛṇvāno 'dya manyase srajaṃ tyaktām iva prāpya lobhād yaudhiṣṭhirīṃ śriyam
english: You now imagine yourself adorned like one wearing a garland — yet through greed you would seize the royal glory of Yudhiṣṭhira as if it were a garland already discarded.

sanskrit: draupadīsahitaṃ pārthaṃ sāyudhair bhrātṛbhir vṛtam vanastham api rājyasthaḥ pāṇḍavaṃ ko 'tijīvati
english: Who, even while established in a kingdom, could outlive the son of Pṛthā accompanied by Draupadī, surrounded by his armed brothers — even when they dwell in the forest?

sanskrit: nideśe yasya rājānaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti kiṃkarāḥ tam ailavilam āsādya dharmarājo vyarājata
english: The dharma-king shone resplendent after obtaining the abode of Ailavila — he at whose command all kings stood ready as servants.

sanskrit: kuberasadanaṃ prāpya tato ratnāny avāpya ca sphītam ākramya te rāṣṭraṃ rājyam icchanti pāṇḍavāḥ
english: Having reached Kubera's dwelling, having gained those treasures, and having overrun that prosperous realm — it is thus that the Pāṇḍavas now desire the kingdom.

sanskrit: dattaṃ hutam adhītaṃ ca brāhmaṇās tarpitā dhanaiḥ āvayor gatam āyuś ca kṛtakṛtyau ca viddhi nau
english: Gifts have been given, oblations poured, scriptures studied, and Brāhmaṇas satisfied with wealth — know that for the two of us our lifespan has been well spent and our purpose fulfilled.

sanskrit: tvaṃ tu hitvā sukhaṃ rājyaṃ mitrāṇi ca dhanāni ca vigrahaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ kṛtvā mahad vyasanam āpsyasi
english: But you, having abandoned a prosperous kingdom, friends, and wealth, by making war against the Pāṇḍavas will bring upon yourself a great calamity.

sanskrit: draupadī yasya cāśāste vijayaṃ satyavādinī tapoghoravratā devī na tvaṃ jeṣyasi pāṇḍavam
english: Draupadī, that truth-speaking goddess of fierce ascetic vows, prays for his victory — you will not conquer the son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: mantrī janārdano yasya bhrātā yasya dhanaṃjayaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathaṃ jeṣyasi pāṇḍavam
english: Whose counsellor is Janārdana, and whose brother is Dhanañjaya, the foremost among all bearers of weapons — how will you conquer the son of Pāṇḍu?

sanskrit: sahāyā brāhmaṇā yasya dhṛtimanto jitendriyāḥ tam ugratapasaṃ vīraṃ kathaṃ jeṣyasi pāṇḍavam
english: Whose allies are firm-souled Brāhmaṇas who have mastered their senses — that hero of fierce austerities — how will you conquer that son of Pāṇḍu?

sanskrit: punar uktaṃ ca vakṣyāmi yat kāryaṃ bhūtim icchatā suhṛdā majjamāneṣu suhṛtsu vyasanārṇave
english: I shall speak again what must be done by one who desires prosperity — by a friend when his friends are sinking in the ocean of calamity.

sanskrit: alaṃ yuddhena tair vīraiḥ śāmya tvaṃ kuruvṛddhaye mā gamaḥ sasutāmātyaḥ sabalaś ca parābhavam
english: Enough of war with those heroes — make peace, for the welfare of the Kurus; do not bring upon yourself, your sons, your ministers, and your army, utter ruin.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca rājaputraiḥ parivṛtas tathāmātyaiś ca saṃjaya upāropya rathe karṇaṃ niryāto madhusūdanaḥ
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: Sañjaya, surrounded by princes and ministers, having taken Karṇa up onto his chariot, how did Madhusūdana depart?

sanskrit: kim abravīd rathopasthe rādheyaṃ paravīrahā kāni sāntvāni govindaḥ sūtaputre prayuktavān
english: What did the slayer of enemy heroes say to Rādheya while on the chariot? What words of conciliation did Govinda employ upon the son of the charioteer?

sanskrit: oghameghasvanaḥ kāle yat kṛṣṇaḥ karṇam abravīt mṛdu vā yadi vā tīkṣṇaṃ tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya
english: Whatever Kṛṣṇa, whose voice is like the roar of rushing clouds, spoke in due time to Karṇa — whether gentle or sharp — tell me all of it, Sañjaya.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca ānupūrvyeṇa vākyāni ślakṣṇāni ca mṛdūni ca priyāṇi dharmayuktāni satyāni ca hitāni ca
english: Sañjaya said: In due order, words that were smooth and gentle, affectionate, grounded in dharma, truthful, and beneficial —

sanskrit: hṛdayagrahaṇīyāni rādheyaṃ madhusūdanaḥ yāny abravīd ameyātmā tāni me śṛṇu bhārata
english: — words that would capture the heart — these the immeasurable-souled Madhusūdana spoke to Rādheya; hear them from me, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca upāsitās te rādheya brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ tattvārthaṃ paripṛṣṭāś ca niyatenānasūyayā
english: Vāsudeva said: O Rādheya, you have attended upon Brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas, and questioned them on the true meaning with discipline and without envy.

sanskrit: tvam eva karṇa jānāsi vedavādān sanātanān tvaṃ hy eva dharmaśāstreṣu sūkṣmeṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ
english: You alone, O Karṇa, know the eternal teachings of the Vedas; you alone are deeply versed in the subtle points of the dharma-shastras.

sanskrit: kānīnaś ca sahoḍhaś ca kanyāyāṃ yaś ca jāyate voḍhāraṃ pitaraṃ tasya prāhuḥ śāstravido janāḥ
english: The son born of a maiden before marriage, the son born along with the bride, and the son born of a maiden — the knowers of scripture declare the husband who marries the mother to be the father of such a child.

sanskrit: so 'si karṇa tathā jātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putro 'si dharmataḥ nigrahād dharmaśāstrāṇām ehi rājā bhaviṣyasi
english: You are such a one, O Karṇa — you are by dharma the son of Pāṇḍu; by the authority of the dharma-shastras, come, and you shall be king.

sanskrit: pitṛpakṣe hi te pārthā mātṛpakṣe ca vṛṣṇayaḥ dvau pakṣāv abhijānīhi tvam etau puruṣarṣabha
english: On your father's side the Pārthas are your kin, and on your mother's side the Vṛṣṇis — acknowledge these two lineages, O bull among men.

sanskrit: mayā sārdham ito yātam adya tvāṃ tāta pāṇḍavāḥ abhijānantu kaunteyaṃ pūrvajātaṃ yudhiṣṭhirāt
english: Come with me from here today, dear one, so the Pāṇḍavas may acknowledge you as the son of Kuntī, the eldest-born before Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: pādau tava grahīṣyanti bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ draupadeyās tathā pañca saubhadraś cāparājitaḥ
english: The five Pāṇḍava brothers shall clasp your feet, as shall the five sons of Draupadī and the unvanquished son of Subhadrā.

sanskrit: rājāno rājaputrāś ca pāṇḍavārthe samāgatāḥ pādau tava grahīṣyanti sarve cāndhakavṛṣṇayaḥ
english: The kings and princes assembled on behalf of the Pāṇḍavas shall clasp your feet, and all the Andhakas and Vṛṣṇis as well.

sanskrit: hiraṇmayāṃś ca te kumbhān rājatān pārthivāṃs tathā oṣadhyaḥ sarvabījāni sarvaratnāni vīrudhaḥ
english: Golden jars, silver ones, and earthen ones, along with herbs, all manner of seeds, all jewels, and plants —

sanskrit: rājanyā rājakanyāś cāpy ānayantv abhiṣecanam ṣaṣṭhe ca tvāṃ tathā kāle draupady upagamiṣyati
english: — let royal ladies and royal princesses bring them for your consecration; and Draupadī too shall come to you in due time as the sixth.

sanskrit: adya tvām abhiṣiñcantu cāturvaidyā dvijātayaḥ purohitaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ vyāghracarmaṇy avasthitam
english: Let the twice-born versed in the four Vedas consecrate you today, seated on a tiger skin as the Pāṇḍavas' chief priest officiates.

sanskrit: tathaiva bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ draupadeyās tathā pañca pāñcālāś cedayas tathā
english: Likewise the five Pāṇḍava brothers, those bulls among men, the five sons of Draupadī, the Pāñcālas, and the Cedis as well —

sanskrit: ahaṃ ca tvābhiṣekṣyāmi rājānaṃ pṛthivīpatim yuvarājo 'stu te rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: — and I myself shall consecrate you as king and lord of the earth; let Yudhiṣṭhira, son of Kuntī, be your crown-prince.

sanskrit: gṛhītvā vyajanaṃ śvetaṃ dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ upānvārohatu rathaṃ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Taking the white fan, the righteous one of firm vows, Yudhiṣṭhira the son of Kuntī, shall mount the chariot following behind you.

sanskrit: chatraṃ ca te mahac chvetaṃ bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ abhiṣiktasya kaunteya kaunteyo dhārayiṣyati
english: The mighty Bhīmasena, son of Kuntī, shall hold the great white parasol over you once you are consecrated, O son of Kuntī.

sanskrit: kiṅkiṇīśatanirghoṣaṃ vaiyāghraparivāraṇam rathaṃ śvetahayair yuktam arjuno vāhayiṣyati
english: Arjuna shall drive the chariot yoked with white horses, resounding with hundreds of bells and adorned with tiger-skins.

sanskrit: abhimanyuś ca te nityaṃ pratyāsanno bhaviṣyati nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca draupadeyāś ca pañca ye
english: Abhimanyu shall always be close by your side, as will Nakula, Sahadeva, and the five sons of Draupadī.

sanskrit: pāñcālās tvānuyāsyanti śikhaṇḍī ca mahārathaḥ ahaṃ ca tvānuyāsyāmi sarve cāndhakavṛṣṇayaḥ dāśārhāḥ parivārās te dāśārṇāś ca viśāṃ pate
english: The Pāñcālas shall follow you, as shall the great warrior Śikhaṇḍin; I too shall follow you, as will all the Andhakas and Vṛṣṇis — the Dāśārhas and Dashernas shall form your retinue, O lord of the people.

sanskrit: bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ mahābāho bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ japair homaiś ca saṃyukto maṅgalaiś ca pṛthagvidhaiḥ
english: Enjoy the kingdom, O mighty-armed one, together with your Pāṇḍava brothers, accompanied by japa, fire-offerings, and auspicious rites of every kind.

sanskrit: purogamāś ca te santu draviḍāḥ saha kuntalaiḥ āndhrās tālacarāś caiva cūcupā veṇupās tathā
english: Let the Draviḍas along with the Kuntalas march before you, as well as the Andhras, the Talacharas, the Chuchupas, and the Venupas.

sanskrit: stuvantu tvādya bahuśaḥ stutibhiḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ vijayaṃ vasuṣeṇasya ghoṣayantu ca pāṇḍavāḥ
english: Let the sutas and magadhas praise you today with many eulogies; let the Pāṇḍavas proclaim the victory of Vasushena.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ parivṛtaḥ pārthair nakṣatrair iva candramāḥ praśādhi rājyaṃ kaunteya kuntīṃ ca pratinandaya
english: You, surrounded by the sons of Pṛthā as the moon is by the stars — rule the kingdom, O son of Kuntī, and bring joy to Kuntī.

sanskrit: mitrāṇi te prahṛṣyantu vyathantu ripavas tathā saubhrātraṃ caiva te 'dyāstu bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
english: Let your friends rejoice and your enemies be shaken; and today let there be true brotherhood between you and the Pāṇḍava brothers.

sanskrit: karṇa uvāca asaṃśayaṃ sauhṛdān me praṇayāc cāttha keśava sakhyena caiva vārṣṇeya śreyaskāmatayaiva ca
english: Karṇa said: Without doubt, O Keśava, you have spoken to me out of friendship, affection, and fellowship, O Vārṣṇeya, and indeed out of a desire for my welfare.

sanskrit: sarvaṃ caivābhijānāmi pāṇḍoḥ putro 'smi dharmataḥ nigrahād dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ yathā tvaṃ kṛṣṇa manyase
english: I know all of this and acknowledge it — I am by dharma the son of Pāṇḍu, by the authority of the dharma-shastras, just as you, O Kṛṣṇa, believe.

sanskrit: kanyā garbhaṃ samādhatta bhāskarān māṃ janārdana ādityavacanāc caiva jātaṃ māṃ sā vyasarjayat
english: A maiden conceived me through Bhāskara, O Janārdana; and by the word of Āditya himself, having borne me, she abandoned me at birth.

sanskrit: so 'smi kṛṣṇa tathā jātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putro 'smi dharmataḥ kuntyā tv aham apākīrṇo yathā na kuśalaṃ tathā
english: Such am I, O Kṛṣṇa — I am by dharma the son of Pāṇḍu; but I was cast off by Kuntī in a manner that was not right or good.

sanskrit: sūto hi mām adhiratho dṛṣṭvaiva anayad gṛhān rādhāyāś caiva māṃ prādāt sauhārdān madhusūdana
english: The charioteer Adhiratha, having found me, brought me to his home and out of affection gave me to Rādhā, O Madhusūdana.

sanskrit: matsnehāc caiva rādhāyāḥ sadyaḥ kṣīram avātarat sā me mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca pratijagrāha mādhava
english: And out of love for me Rādhā's milk flowed at once; she accepted my urine and excrement, O Mādhava.

sanskrit: tasyāḥ piṇḍavyapanayaṃ kuryād asmadvidhaḥ katham dharmavid dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ śravaṇe satataṃ rataḥ
english: How could one such as I, a knower of dharma, ever neglect to perform the funeral oblations for her — one who is ever devoted to hearing the dharma-shastras?

sanskrit: tathā mām abhijānāti sūtaś cādhirathaḥ sutam pitaraṃ cābhijānāmi tam ahaṃ sauhṛdāt sadā
english: The charioteer Adhiratha likewise acknowledges me as his son, and I always acknowledge him as my father with heartfelt love.

sanskrit: sa hi me jātakarmādi kārayām āsa mādhava śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā putraprītyā janārdana
english: For he performed for me the birth-rites and all the sacraments from the beginning, O Mādhava, according to the rites prescribed by scripture, with the joy of a father, O Janārdana.

sanskrit: nāma me vasuṣeṇeti kārayām āsa vai dvijaiḥ bhāryāś coḍhā mama prāpte yauvane tena keśava
english: He had twice-born priests give me the name Vasushena; and when I came of age, it was he who arranged my marriages, O Keśava.

sanskrit: tāsu putrāś ca pautrāś ca mama jātā janārdana tāsu me hṛdayaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃjātaṃ kāmabandhanam
english: By those wives sons and grandsons have been born to me, O Janārdana; in them, O Kṛṣṇa, my heart has become bound by the ties of love.

sanskrit: na pṛthivyā sakalayā na suvarṇasya rāśibhiḥ harṣād bhayād vā govinda anṛtaṃ vaktum utsahe
english: Not for the sake of the whole earth, not for heaps of gold, neither from joy nor from fear, O Govinda, do I venture to speak falsehood.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrakule kṛṣṇa duryodhanasamāśrayāt mayā trayodaśa samā bhuktaṃ rājyam akaṇṭakam
english: In the house of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, O Kṛṣṇa, under the shelter of Duryodhana, I have enjoyed uncontested royal power for thirteen years.

sanskrit: iṣṭaṃ ca bahubhir yajñaiḥ saha sūtair mayāsakṛt āvāhāś ca vivāhāś ca saha sūtaiḥ kṛtā mayā
english: I have performed many sacrifices together with the sutas, and betrothal-feasts and weddings have been celebrated by me together with the sutas more than once.

sanskrit: māṃ ca kṛṣṇa samāśritya kṛtaḥ śastrasamudyamaḥ duryodhanena vārṣṇeya vigrahaś cāpi pāṇḍavaiḥ
english: And it is relying on me, O Kṛṣṇa, that Duryodhana, O Vārṣṇeya, has taken up arms and entered into conflict with the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: tasmād raṇe dvairathe māṃ pratyudyātāram acyuta vṛtavān paramaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ pratīpaṃ savyasācinaḥ
english: Therefore it is against me, who comes forward to face him in single chariot combat, O Acyuta, that Savyasācī has chosen to stand in opposition, with utmost eagerness.

sanskrit: vadhād bandhād bhayād vāpi lobhād vāpi janārdana anṛtaṃ notsahe kartuṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya dhīmataḥ
english: For fear of death, bondage, or out of fear, or out of greed, O Janārdana, I am not able to speak falsely against the wise son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: yadi hy adya na gaccheyaṃ dvairathaṃ savyasācinā akīrtiḥ syād dhṛṣīkeśa mama pārthasya cobhayoḥ
english: For if I were not to go today to the single chariot duel with Savyasācī, O Hrishikesha, it would bring infamy upon both myself and the son of Pṛthā.

sanskrit: asaṃśayaṃ hitārthāya brūyās tvaṃ madhusūdana sarvaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ kuryus tvadvaśitvān na saṃśayaḥ
english: Without doubt you speak for my good, O Madhusūdana, and the Pāṇḍavas would do whatever you say, being wholly under your sway — there is no doubt of that.

sanskrit: mantrasya niyamaṃ kuryās tvam atra puruṣottama etad atra hitaṃ manye sarvayādavanandana
english: You should ensure the secrecy of this counsel, O Puruṣottama; that I consider to be the beneficial course here, O delight of all the Yādavas.

sanskrit: yadi jānāti māṃ rājā dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ kuntyāḥ prathamajaṃ putraṃ na sa rājyaṃ grahīṣyati
english: If the king, that righteous one of firm vows, were to know me as the first-born son of Kuntī, he would not accept the kingdom.

sanskrit: prāpya cāpi mahad rājyaṃ tad ahaṃ madhusūdana sphītaṃ duryodhanāyaiva saṃpradadyām ariṃdama
english: And even if I obtained that great and prosperous kingdom, O Madhusūdana, O crusher of enemies, I would give it all over to Duryodhana alone.

sanskrit: sa eva rājā dharmātmā śāśvato 'stu yudhiṣṭhiraḥ netā yasya hṛṣīkeśo yoddhā yasya dhanaṃjayaḥ
english: Let Yudhiṣṭhira, that ever-righteous soul, be the eternal king — whose guide is Hrishikesha and whose warrior is Dhanañjaya.

sanskrit: pṛthivī tasya rāṣṭraṃ ca yasya bhīmo mahārathaḥ nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca draupadeyāś ca mādhava
english: The earth and the kingdom belong to him whose great warrior is Bhīma, and who has Nakula, Sahadeva, and the sons of Draupadī, O Mādhava.

sanskrit: uttamaujā yudhāmanyuḥ satyadharmā ca somakiḥ caidyaś ca cekitānaś ca śikhaṇḍī cāparājitaḥ
english: Uttamaujas, Yudhāmanyu, the Somaka of true dharma, Chaidya, Cekitāna, and the unvanquished Śikhaṇḍī —

sanskrit: indragopakavarṇāś ca kekayā bhrātaras tathā indrāyudhasavarṇaś ca kuntibhojo mahārathaḥ
english: — those of Indragopaka hue, the Kekaya brothers as well, and Kuntibhoja the great warrior, of the colour of Indra's rainbow —

sanskrit: mātulo bhīmasenasya senajic ca mahārathaḥ śaṅkhaḥ putro virāṭasya nidhis tvaṃ ca janārdana
english: — the maternal uncle of Bhīmasena, and the great warrior Senajit, Śaṅkha the son of Virāṭa, and you yourself, O Janārdana, his treasure —

sanskrit: mahān ayaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛtaḥ kṣatrasya samudānayaḥ rājyaṃ prāptam idaṃ dīptaṃ prathitaṃ sarvarājasu
english: This is a great mustering of the kshatriya order you have assembled, O Kṛṣṇa; this blazing and celebrated kingdom has been won and is renowned among all kings.

sanskrit: dhārtarāṣṭrasya vārṣṇeya śastrayajño bhaviṣyati asya yajñasya vettā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi janārdana ādhvaryavaṃ ca te kṛṣṇa kratāv asmin bhaviṣyati
english: The son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's weapon-sacrifice shall take place, O Vārṣṇeya; you shall be the knower of this sacrifice, O Janārdana; and you, O Kṛṣṇa, shall perform the role of the Adhvaryu priest in this rite.

sanskrit: hotā caivātra bībhatsuḥ saṃnaddhaḥ sa kapidhvajaḥ gāṇḍīvaṃ sruk tathājyaṃ ca vīryaṃ puṃsāṃ bhaviṣyati
english: Bībhatsu, girt for battle and bearing the monkey-banner, shall be the hotar-priest; the Gāṇḍīva shall be the sacrificial ladle, valor the clarified butter.

sanskrit: aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brāhmaṃ sthūṇākarṇaṃ ca mādhava mantrās tatra bhaviṣyanti prayuktāḥ savyasācinā
english: The Aindra, the Pāśupata, the Brahmā, and the Sthūṇākarṇa weapons, O Mādhava — these shall be the mantras deployed there by Savyasācī.

sanskrit: anuyātaś ca pitaram adhiko vā parākrame grāvastotraṃ sa saubhadraḥ samyak tatra kariṣyati
english: Abhimanyu, the son of Subhadrā — who follows his father or surpasses him in valor — shall properly perform the role of the Gravastotrin chanter there.

sanskrit: udgātātra punar bhīmaḥ prastotā sumahābalaḥ vinadan sa naravyāghro nāgānīkāntakṛd raṇe
english: Bhīma of immense strength shall again be the Udgatar singer there, the Prostota — that tiger among men who roars and destroys armies of elephants in battle.

sanskrit: sa caiva tatra dharmātmā śaśvad rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ japair homaiś ca saṃyukto brahmatvaṃ kārayiṣyati
english: And that ever-righteous king Yudhiṣṭhira himself, engaged in prayer and fire-offerings, shall perform the office of the Brahmin priest there.

sanskrit: śaṅkhaśabdāḥ samurajā bheryaś ca madhusūdana utkṛṣṭasiṃhanādāś ca subrahmaṇyo bhaviṣyati
english: The sounds of conches, the roll of drums, and the kettledrums, O Madhusūdana, and the exalted lion-roars — these shall be the Subrahmania chants of this sacrifice.

sanskrit: nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca mādrīputrau yaśasvinau śāmitraṃ tau mahāvīryau samyak tatra kariṣyataḥ
english: Nakula and Sahadeva, the glorious sons of Mādrī, those two of great valor, shall duly perform the Shamitra rite there.

sanskrit: kalmāṣadaṇḍā govinda vimalā rathaśaktayaḥ yūpāḥ samupakalpantām asmin yajñe janārdana
english: Let the sacrificial posts be prepared for this sacrifice, O Govinda, O Janārdana — the speckled-shafted, pure chariot-javelins.

sanskrit: karṇinālīkanārācā vatsadantopabṛṃhaṇāḥ tomarāḥ somakalaśāḥ pavitrāṇi dhanūṃṣi ca
english: Karṇa-arrows, reed shafts, iron arrows, and Vatsadanta-tipped bolts, lances, Soma-vessels, straining-cloths, and bows — let these be the implements of this sacrifice.
